abstract_class_declaration.note: abstract class Base — symbol emitted (probe-verified); abstract_method_signature members

type_alias_declaration.note: type Fn = ... — symbol emitted (probe-verified); RHS type references are gap T2

generator_function_declaration.note: generator flag via function* — probe-verified in existing fixtures

function_expression.note: const f = function() {} — symbol emitted with owner (probe-verified)

arrow_function.note: const f = () => {} — symbol emitted; locals inside body suppressed (module/class-level only)

lexical_declaration.note: const raw: User = ... — symbol emitted; declared_type ref attributed to enclosing scope (probe-verified)

variable_declaration.note: var/let at module/class level — symbol emitted (probe-verified)

internal_module.note: declare module / namespace Foo — symbol emitted (probe-verified)

import_statement.note: import edges emitted with target module:item; evidence tier is gap T1 (usage_contextual instead of import_based)

export_statement.note: export { a as b } from ... — exports edges emitted (probe-verified)

import_alias.note: import x = require('m') — import_alias emitted as constant (probe-verified)

type_annotation.note: param/field/property type clauses — declared_type; return position after formal_parameters — return_type (probe-verified)

type_identifier.note: Foo in type positions — collected via collectTypeNames

nested_type_identifier.note: A.B in type positions — full dotted target

predefined_type.note: string/number/boolean primitives — filtered by PRIMITIVES set

tuple_type.note: [A, B] in annotation — element types collected; RHS of type_alias is gap T2

conditional_type.note: T extends U ? X : Y in annotation — collected recursively

mapped_type_clause.note: [K in keyof T] — type names collected (probe-verified)

as_expression.note: x as Foo — cast_target (probe-verified, fixture type-usage-graph)

satisfies_expression.note: x satisfies Foo — NO reference emitted (gap T5)

binary_expression.note: x instanceof Foo — instanceof_check (probe-verified, fixture type-usage-graph)

instantiation_expression.note: f<Baz>(x) — type argument refs NOT emitted (gap T9)

jsx_element.note: <Button> — capitalized JSX components emit uses (probe-verified via tsx wasm); tsx dialect

jsx_self_closing_element.note: <Button /> — capitalized JSX components emit uses; tsx dialect

member_expression.note: receiver.selector — calls when selector invoked; field-access Uses is gap T4

subscript_expression.note: xs[i] — indexing; Uses on receiver is gap T4

template_string.note: `hi ${name}` — interpolation Uses on name is gap T3

template_substitution.note: ${name} — Uses on the substituted identifier is gap T3

object_pattern.note: const { a, b } = src — destructured locals become symbols at module level; false reference collision is gap T6

_notes: tsx dialect: tree-sitter-tsx.wasm adds 13 jsx node types (jsx_element, jsx_opening_element, ...). The analyzer's jsx handling is probe-verified with the tsx wasm; the completeness gate enumerates the typescript wasm (191 named types). The 13 jsx types are handled_verified via the tsx dialect note in the completeness classification.

declared_type refs attribute to the enclosing scope (class/function/module); top-level const annotations resolve to 'global' — the module-scope sentinel, consistent with the analyzer's per-file contract.
